primaryTextRead.text: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

wikipediaRead.locator: L1872–1875: the Bilhan subsection distinguishes two namesakes and names Zethan as a son of the Benjamite Bilhan, citing 1 Chronicles 7:10.
